operative_text:
Section 1 (new s. 790.223, F.S.): After January 1, 2023, a person may not possess, purchase, transport, or receive an unfinished frame or receiver, unless: 1. The person is a firearms importer or manufacturer; or 2. The unfinished frame or receiver is imprinted with a serial number issued by a firearms importer or manufacturer and the unfinished frame or receiver has been imprinted with the serial number pursuant to federal law.
